name: Leonida Legend
description: Good luck out there. (Earn all other trophies.)
guide: This one unlocks on its own the moment every other trophy in the set pops, so there is nothing separate to hunt. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then cleanup, races, money, the 100% push and finally the hard-mode runs — and keep the checklist here ticking over as you go. If it is the last empty box on your list, you are already done.

name: Welcome to Leonida
description: Reach Leonida.
guide: Awarded automatically as the story brings you into Leonida, so just start a new game and play the opening. There is nothing to prepare and nothing you can skip past. Spoiler caution: play on and let the opening unfold rather than reading ahead.

name: Just a Scratch
description: Complete the Prologue.
guide: Finish the Prologue chapter and this silver is yours; it cannot be missed because the rest of the story is locked behind it. Take the time to learn the controls and the cover system while the stakes are low. Spoiler caution: the Prologue sets up everything that follows, so go in blind.

name: Backseat Driver
description: Play through an entire Jason mission without ever taking control of the vehicle.
guide: Pick a Jason mission with a driving section and stay in the passenger role from start to finish — never take the wheel when prompted. If a section forces you into the driver's seat, that mission will not count, so choose one that keeps you riding along the whole way. Spoiler caution: mission specifics are best discovered in play.

name: No Sudden Moves
description: Play through an entire Lucia mission without running.
guide: Play a full Lucia mission at walking pace: no sprinting from the first objective to the last. Simply leave the run input alone, take your time in fights, and let the mission play out slowly. Spoiler caution: pick the mission in game rather than from a walkthrough.

name: Island Hopping
description: Complete all Jason story missions.
guide: Work through every one of Jason's story missions; they are marked on the map as his storyline advances. If you finish the main story with this still locked, check for any of his markers you skipped between chapters. Spoiler caution: the mission list itself reveals story beats, so rely on the in-game markers.

name: Double Life
description: Complete all Lucia story missions.
guide: Complete Lucia's full story mission chain, following her markers whenever they appear alongside Jason's. Alternating between the two leads as the game suggests keeps both chains moving. Spoiler caution: her arc carries some of the biggest turns, so no details here.

name: One Last Score
description: Complete all heist setup missions.
guide: Finish every heist setup mission — the preparation jobs that feed into the big scores. They are offered as the story builds toward each heist, so accept setup work whenever it appears instead of pushing straight to the finale. Spoiler caution: setups hint at how each heist plays out.

name: Grand Theft Finale
description: Complete the main story on any difficulty.
guide: See the main story through to its end on any difficulty, so feel free to play on the setting you enjoy most. The harder completion trophies can be handled on later runs, which the roadmap covers in its final stage. Spoiler caution: nothing about the ending belongs in a guide — just play.

name: Two Sides
description: Start the story as both Jason and Lucia.
guide: Begin the story playing as Jason and as Lucia; the campaign introduces both leads early on. If you have played a while without this popping, you have likely only controlled one of them so far — keep following the opening chapters. Spoiler caution: who you start as is part of the introduction.

name: Second Chances
description: Choose the alternate path in any branching story mission.
guide: When a branching story mission offers two paths, deliberately take the alternate one. You do not need a second playthrough for this — the first branch you meet is enough, just pick the less obvious option. Spoiler caution: the branches are story choices, so choose in the moment.

name: Against All Odds
description: Finish a story mission with 1% health remaining.
guide: Finish a story mission while your health sits at the sliver the description asks for — 1%. The practical way is to clear a mission's final fight, then let light damage wear you down before you trigger the ending. Do not heal by accident on the way in. Spoiler caution: attempt it on a replayed mission if you want zero story risk.

name: Photo Finish
description: Win the Leonida Street Series final by less than one second.
guide: Win the Leonida Street Series final with a margin under one second. Bring a well-tuned car and race clean; if you are comfortably ahead near the line, ease off just enough to keep the gap tight without giving up the win. A blown lead does not count — you must cross first.

name: Marathon Man
description: Run the full length of the Leonida Keys causeway on foot.
guide: Run the full length of the Leonida Keys causeway on foot, end to end, without hopping into a vehicle. Start at one end with full stamina, follow the road, and treat it as a sightseeing jog — it is a long one, so settle in. Driving any stretch means starting over.

name: High Roller
description: Win $25,000 in a single hand of poker.
guide: Win $25,000 in a single hand of poker. That takes a big pot, so build your bankroll first, sit at the highest-stakes table you can, and wait for a genuinely strong hand before committing — one lucky hand is all it needs. Save before the session so a bad run costs you nothing.

name: Vice City Nights
description: Visit every type of nightlife venue in Vice City.
guide: Visit every type of nightlife venue Vice City offers — each distinct category of late-night spot on the map. Work district by district, stepping inside each new type of venue once; repeats of a type you have already visited do not add anything. The in-game map's venue icons are your checklist.

name: Keys to the Keys
description: Own a property in the Leonida Keys.
guide: Buy any property in the Leonida Keys — the cheapest one counts. Earn cash through missions and side work until you can afford it, then purchase through the property listing. Owning it also gives you a foothold for the wider property trophies.

name: Drone Ace
description: Win every drone race in Vice Beach.
guide: Win every drone race in Vice Beach. Learn each course's line first with a practice run, then chase the win once you know the gates; the tight beachfront corners reward braking early over raw speed. Keep at it course by course until every Vice Beach race is won.

name: Wet and Wild
description: Complete all wave runner races.
guide: Complete all the wave runner races — unlike the win-everything trophies, these only ask you to finish. Stay on the course, hit the checkpoints, and do not worry about the podium. Rough water rewards a steady line over full throttle.

name: Street King
description: Win every street race in Leonida.
guide: Win every street race in Leonida. Unlock and clear them region by region, upgrading your car as the competition stiffens. If one race keeps beating you, learn its lines in a free run before retrying.

name: Off the Grid
description: Live off the map for 24 in-game hours without using a phone or vehicle.
guide: Spend 24 in-game hours using no phone and no vehicle. Park yourself somewhere safe on foot — a beach or a quiet corner of the map — and let the clock run, keeping your character out of trouble. Opening the phone or getting into any vehicle resets the attempt, so put both out of reach.

name: Animal Friend
description: Photograph 20 different animal species.
guide: Photograph 20 different animal species with the in-game camera. Different habitats hold different wildlife — beaches, wetlands, farmland and open water are all worth a visit. Keep the camera ready whenever you explore somewhere new, and check your photo log to see which species you already have.

name: Bird's Eye
description: Reach the highest point in Leonida and jump off.
guide: Reach the highest point in Leonida, then jump off it. Survey the map for the tallest peak or structure, get yourself up there, and take the leap — bring a parachute if you want to enjoy the view on the way down. The trophy is for the jump, not the landing.

name: Treasure Hunter
description: Find 10 buried caches across the Leonida Keys.
guide: Find 10 buried caches scattered across the Leonida Keys. Explore the islands and shorelines carefully — caches reward players who search off the road. Your count carries across the whole Keys, so sweep island by island and keep track in the checklist here.

name: Completionist
description: Reach 100% game completion.
guide: Reach 100% game completion. This is the long haul: story, side content, collectibles, races and activities all feed the percentage. Use the in-game completion screen to find what is left, and treat the roadmap's cleanup stages as your route. Nothing here needs a special difficulty, so play it your way.

name: Wanted Level
description: Survive a 5-star wanted level for 10 minutes.
guide: Survive a 5-star wanted level for 10 minutes. Raise your wanted level somewhere with cover and escape routes, then keep moving — a position with limited entrances is easier to hold than open ground. Stock up on health and armor before you start the chaos.

name: Clean Getaway
description: Escape a 4-star wanted level without being spotted during the escape.
guide: Escape a 4-star wanted level without being spotted during the escape itself. Once you break line of sight, stay broken: no crossing search cones, no brushing past patrols. Ditch your vehicle if it is burned, and wait out the stars somewhere quiet.

name: Zen Master
description: Complete every sunrise meditation across Leonida.
guide: Complete every sunrise meditation across Leonida. These are time-sensitive — arrive before sunrise and begin as the sun comes up. Plan a route between spots across several in-game mornings rather than trying to rush them all at once.

name: Fashion Forward
description: Own every clothing item in a single store.
guide: Buy every clothing item sold in a single store — pick the smallest store you can find so the bill stays manageable, and work through its full stock rack by rack. Caution: money spent here is gone for good, so keep a separate save before you commit to the spree in case you would rather spend that cash elsewhere.

name: Home Sweet Home
description: Fully upgrade your first safehouse.
guide: Fully upgrade your first safehouse — buy every upgrade it offers. Earn cash, return to the safehouse upgrade menu, and work down the list until nothing is left to buy. The first safehouse's upgrade list is the shortest path to this one.

name: Car Collector
description: Own 15 different vehicles at once.
guide: Own 15 different vehicles at the same time. Duplicates do not help — they must be different models, and you must still own all of them at once, so stop selling cars until this pops. Store them across your garages and buy cheap, distinct models to fill out the count.

name: Property Mogul
description: Own every purchasable property in Leonida.
guide: Own every purchasable property in Leonida. This is an endgame money sink: work the story and side income first, then buy properties district by district as your cash allows. The map is your checklist — any property still showing a for-sale listing is one you still need.

name: First Million
description: Hold $1,000,000 in cash at one time.
guide: Hold $1,000,000 in cash at one time — money already spent does not count toward the moment it checks. Caution: the description asks for cash held, not cash earned in total, so keep a separate save and resist big purchases — properties, vehicles, store buyouts — until this has popped, then spend freely.

name: Spray Artist
description: Find every spray wall and leave your mark.
guide: Find every spray wall in the game and leave your mark at each one. Walls hide in alleys, underpasses and the backs of buildings, so explore on foot and watch for the prompt when you pass one. This pairs naturally with the map-cleanup stage of the roadmap.

name: Radio Star
description: Listen to every radio station for at least one minute each.
guide: Listen to every radio station for at least one minute each. Sit in a vehicle, flip through the dial one station at a time, and give each a full minute before moving on. It is the easiest trophy on the list to finish during a long drive — just do not change station early.

name: Social Climber
description: Reach maximum follower count on the in-game social app.
guide: Reach the maximum follower count on the in-game social app. Post and engage with everything the app rewards, and keep feeding it as you play — photos, stunts and story progress are the usual fuel. Check your follower count in the app to see how close the cap is.

name: Helping Hand
description: Complete every stranger side mission.
guide: Complete every stranger side mission — the odd jobs offered by people you meet out in the world. Accept them when they appear rather than driving past, because the description ties this to all of them. Caution: if a stranger's offer can be refused or passed by as the story moves on, you could lose access to it, so keep a separate save and mop these up before pushing the story to its point of no return.

name: Random Acts
description: Complete 25 random world events.
guide: Complete 25 random world events. These pop up as you travel — keep an eye out while driving between objectives and detour whenever one triggers. Twenty-five sounds like a lot, but they accumulate naturally if you stop skipping them.

name: Full Tank
description: Drive 500 total miles in a single vehicle.
guide: Drive 500 total miles in a single vehicle. Pick one car early, make it your daily driver, and resist swapping — the miles only count in that one vehicle. Road trips for other trophies — races, collectibles, postcards — all feed this if you take the same car.

name: Sky High
description: Pilot every type of aircraft in the game.
guide: Pilot every type of aircraft in the game — planes, helicopters and anything else that flies. Visit airfields and helipads, and take each new type up at least once. If a type is locked behind a purchase or a mission, note it and come back during cleanup.

name: Deep Blue
description: Explore the sunken wreck off the Leonida Keys.
guide: Explore the sunken wreck off the Leonida Keys. You will need a way to stay underwater — take a boat out toward the wreck site and dive it properly, searching the whole structure rather than skimming the top. The Keys' waters hide it, so work the coastline methodically.

name: Postcard Collector
description: Send a postcard from every named area in Leonida.
guide: Send a postcard from every named area in Leonida. As you unlock and visit each new area on the map, find its postcard point and send one before you leave. A district-by-district sweep during cleanup keeps this from becoming a backtracking chore at the end.

name: Diplomat
description: End a gang encounter peacefully through dialogue.
guide: End a gang encounter peacefully through dialogue. When a confrontation starts, choose the talk options instead of reaching for a weapon, and keep choosing them until the encounter stands down. Not every encounter may offer the choice — take the first one that does all the way to a peaceful end.

name: Pacifist Run
description: Complete any heist without firing a single shot.
guide: Complete any heist without firing a single shot. Pick the heist with the strongest stealth or social route, plan it that way from the setup stage, and let your crew handle any unavoidable noise. Caution: the description ties this to one clean heist run, so keep a separate save before the heist starts — one stray shot means reloading rather than replaying the whole game.

name: The Shootist
description: Earn gold on all Shooting Range challenges.
guide: Earn gold on all Shooting Range challenges — community trackers (Exophase and PSNProfiles) list 42 challenges in the range's set. Learn one weapon category at a time, chase accuracy over speed, and replay a challenge immediately while its target pattern is fresh. Caution: range progress is easiest to grind in one focused stretch, so keep a separate save before the story's point of no return in case you want to return to the range late in the game.

name: Bullseye
description: Hit 10 consecutive headshots without missing.
guide: Land 10 consecutive headshots without a single miss. Pick a slow, controlled weapon and a calm situation — unaware targets at close distance give you the steadiest shots. Aim carefully and take your time between shots; rushing is what breaks the chain.

name: No Stone Unturned
description: Discover every hidden location on the map.
guide: Discover every hidden location on the map. This is exploration in its purest form: sweep the map grid by grid, on foot where vehicles cannot go, and check rooftops, alleys and interiors. Caution: with the whole map to cover, one spot left behind a story-locked door would sink the run, so keep a separate save and do a final sweep before the point of no return.

name: True Ending
description: Make every major choice the same way in one playthrough.
guide: Make every major choice the same way in one playthrough — pick your philosophy at the first big decision and never waver. Caution: the description ties this to consistency across a single run, so keep a separate save from the very start of the playthrough; one change of heart means a fresh run. Spoiler caution: the choices themselves are the story, so decide by instinct, not by guide.

name: Completionist Prime
description: Reach 100% completion without lowering the difficulty.
guide: Reach 100% completion without lowering the difficulty. Set your difficulty at the start and leave it there for the entire run — the moment it drops, the run no longer qualifies. Caution: because a single settings change can void the whole attempt, keep a separate save and double-check the difficulty before every long session.

name: Master of Leonida
description: Reach 100% completion on the hardest difficulty.
guide: Reach 100% completion on the hardest difficulty — the full game, at its toughest, with nothing skipped. Do this as a dedicated run after you know the game from your first playthrough, and lean on every route the roadmap taught you. Caution: this is the longest commitment in the set, so keep a separate save and never touch the difficulty setting mid-run.

name: Neon Nights
description: Take a photo at every neon sign in Vice City at night.
guide: Take a photo at every neon sign in Vice City at night. Wait for dark, then tour the city's lit districts with the camera out — signs you photographed in daylight do not count. One night's loop through the brightest districts covers a lot of them.

name: Wave Rider
description: Surf the biggest wave during a storm.
guide: Surf the biggest wave during a storm. Storms are the trigger: when bad weather rolls in, get to the surf and ride the largest swell you can find. Watch the weather rather than waiting idly — storm systems pass, so be ready to move when one arrives.

name: Full House
description: Fill every seat in a stolen transit bus with passengers.
guide: Fill every seat of a stolen transit bus with passengers. Take the bus to where people actually wait, then work the stops through busy districts until every seat is taken. Keep the driving smooth and stick to populated stops.

name: Garage King
description: Store a vehicle in every garage you own.
guide: Store a vehicle in every garage you own. As your property list grows, make sure each garage actually holds a car — an empty garage does not count. Do a final round of your properties at cleanup time and park something in any garage you find empty.

name: Completionist Eternal
description: Reach 100% completion in a second playthrough.
guide: Reach 100% completion in a second playthrough. Start a fresh run after your first 100% and do it all again — the good news is you will know every route, race line and collectible the second time. Pair it with the hard-mode trophies in the roadmap's final stage so one extra playthrough earns several trophies at once.
